items.prompt: For target 0 and values [-1,1,-1,1], what answer follows the signed prefix-count rule?

options.why: That counts only adjacent opposite pairs, omitting nonadjacent valid pairs.
Negative values are valid and can have positive complements.
Each of the two negative occurrences pairs with each of the two positive occurrences.
The equal-sign pairs do not sum to 0.

items.explanation: Each of the two negative occurrences pairs with each of the two positive occurrences.
